---
title: "Global abundance-weighted vOTU taxonomy tree"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    code-fold: false
editor: source
execute:
  enabled: false
---

One abundance-weighted taxonomy tree summarises all samples.
Each of the 12 samples contributes equally: normalise the reads mapped to all
634 high-quality, viral-gene-positive representative vOTUs within each sample,
then average those proportions. Taxonomy and counts are from the independently
raw-input-verified v4 rank review. No low-abundance taxa or unknowns are removed.

Node area and branch width encode mean clade abundance; colour denotes realm.
Clade abundance includes vOTUs assigned directly to the node plus descendants.
Parent and child values are nested, not additive. Branch lengths are only layout.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh analysis/votu_global_abundance_tree.qmd NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
python3 tests/test_votu_global_tree.py NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
```

```{r}
#| label: global-votu-tree
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ape)
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(scales)
})
check <- function(ok,msg) if(!isTRUE(ok)) stop(msg,call.=FALSE)
repo <- normalizePath(getwd())
source(file.path(repo,"R/figure_style.R"))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
check(length(args)==1L,"Supply a new output directory")
output <- normalizePath(args[[1]],mustWork=FALSE)
check(!file.exists(output),"Output exists; choose a new version")
data <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_DATA_ROOT",
  "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569"))
review <- file.path(data,"derived/votu_taxonomic_resolution_review_2026-09-13-v4")
input_paths <- c(taxonomy=file.path(review,"tables/catalogue_rank_assignments.tsv"),
                 counts=file.path(review,"tables/votu_sample_counts.tsv"))
hash <- function(p) substr(system2("shasum",c("-a","256",shQuote(p)),stdout=TRUE)[[1]],1,64)
old_hashes <- fread(file.path(review,"output_sha256.tsv"))
for(p in input_paths) {
  rel <- substring(p,nchar(review)+2L)
  check(identical(hash(p),old_hashes[path==rel,sha256]),"Input changed since verified rank review")
}
taxa <- fread(input_paths[["taxonomy"]],na.strings=c("","NA"))
counts <- fread(input_paths[["counts"]])
check(nrow(taxa)==634L && !anyDuplicated(taxa$contig_id),"Expected 634 unique vOTUs")
check(uniqueN(counts$sample_title)==12L && nrow(counts)==634L*12L &&
      !anyDuplicated(counts[,.(contig_id,sample_title)]),"Incomplete/duplicated sample grid")
check(setequal(taxa$contig_id,counts$contig_id) && all(is.finite(counts$reads)&counts$reads>=0),"Invalid counts")
totals <- counts[,.(total_reads=sum(reads)),by=sample_title]
check(all(totals$total_reads>0),"Zero sample denominator")
counts <- merge(counts,totals,by="sample_title")
counts[, proportion:=reads/total_reads]
weights <- counts[,.(mean_abundance=mean(proportion)),by=contig_id]
check(abs(sum(weights$mean_abundance)-1)<1e-12,"Global weights do not sum to one")
prefix <- c(realm="r_",kingdom="k_",phylum="p_",class="c_",order="o_",
            family="f_",subfamily="sf_",genus="g_",species="s_")
nodes <- data.table(node_id="n000",parent=NA_character_,rank="root",taxon="All vOTUs",
                    display="All vOTUs",realm="root",depth=0L)
node_lookup <- new.env(parent=emptyenv())
assignments <- vector("list",nrow(taxa))
for(i in seq_len(nrow(taxa))) {
  parent <- "n000"; depth <- 0L
  for(rank in names(prefix)) {
    value <- taxa[[rank]][[i]]
    if(is.na(value)||!nzchar(value)) next
    key <- paste(parent,rank,value,sep="|")
    if(!exists(key,envir=node_lookup,inherits=FALSE)) {
      id <- sprintf("n%03d",nrow(nodes)); depth <- depth+1L
      nodes <- rbind(nodes,data.table(node_id=id,parent=parent,rank=rank,taxon=value,
        display=paste0(prefix[[rank]],value),realm=taxa$realm[[i]],depth=depth))
      assign(key,id,envir=node_lookup)
    }
    parent <- get(key,envir=node_lookup,inherits=FALSE)
    parent_key <- parent
    depth <- nodes[node_id==parent_key,depth]
  }
  if(parent=="n000") parent <- "unknown"
  assignments[[i]] <- data.table(contig_id=taxa$contig_id[[i]],assigned_node=parent)
}
nodes <- rbind(nodes,data.table(node_id="unknown",parent="n000",rank="unclassified",
  taxon="Unclassified",display="Unclassified",realm="Unclassified",depth=1L))
assigned <- rbindlist(assignments)
assigned <- merge(assigned,weights,by="contig_id")
direct <- assigned[,.(direct_abundance=sum(mean_abundance),direct_votus=.N),by=assigned_node]
nodes <- merge(nodes,direct,by.x="node_id",by.y="assigned_node",all.x=TRUE,sort=FALSE)
nodes[is.na(direct_abundance),`:=`(direct_abundance=0,direct_votus=0L)]
nodes[, `:=`(clade_abundance=direct_abundance,clade_votus=direct_votus)]
for(d in rev(sort(unique(nodes$depth)))) {
  if(d==0L) next
  for(id in nodes[depth==d,node_id]) {
    parent_id <- nodes[node_id==id,parent]
    value <- nodes[node_id==id,.(clade_abundance,clade_votus)]
    nodes[node_id==parent_id,`:=`(clade_abundance=clade_abundance+value$clade_abundance,
                                 clade_votus=clade_votus+value$clade_votus)]
  }
}
check(nodes[node_id=="n000",clade_votus]==634L &&
      abs(nodes[node_id=="n000",clade_abundance]-1)<1e-12,"Root does not conserve abundance")
check(sum(nodes$direct_votus)==634L && abs(sum(nodes$direct_abundance)-1)<1e-12,
      "Deepest assignments are not a partition")
# A deterministic cladogram, with identifiers retained for every internal node.
newick <- function(id) {
  children <- nodes[parent==id][order(realm,-clade_abundance,display)]$node_id
  if(!length(children)) return(id)
  paste0("(",paste(vapply(children,newick,character(1)),collapse=","),")",id)
}
tree <- read.tree(text=paste0(newick("n000"),";"))
set.seed(913)
layout <- ggtree(tree,layout="daylight",branch.length="none")
xy <- as.data.table(layout$data)[,.(node,label,parent,x,y,isTip)]
check(setequal(xy$label,nodes$node_id),"Tree layout changed node identities")
xy <- merge(xy,nodes,by.x="label",by.y="node_id",suffixes=c(".tree",".tax"))
# Rotate the unrooted layout to use the landscape page efficiently.
xy[, `:=`(x_rot=y,y_rot=-x)]
xy[, `:=`(x=x_rot,y=y_rot)]
edges <- merge(xy[parent.tree!=node,.(parent.tree,xend=x,yend=y,realm,clade_abundance)],
               xy[,.(parent.tree=node,x,y)],by="parent.tree")
# Graph geometry is only taxonomy context. Colour key stays consistent with prior figures.
colours <- phage_uv_viral_realm_colours
check(all(na.omit(nodes[rank!="root",realm]) %in% names(colours)),"Missing realm colour")
xy[, realm:=fifelse(is.na(realm),"Unclassified",realm)]
xy[, label_text:=display]
# Label groups >=0.05% directly assigned abundance, plus realm roots and major classes.
xy[, show_label:=direct_abundance>=0.0005 | rank=="realm" | (rank=="class" & clade_abundance>=.01)]
xy[rank=="root",show_label:=FALSE]
# formatC needs a scalar precision; construct labels explicitly for mixed magnitudes.
xy[show_label==TRUE,label_text:=vapply(seq_len(.N),function(i) paste0(display[[i]],"\n",
  formatC(100*clade_abundance[[i]],format="f",digits=if(clade_abundance[[i]]>=.01)1 else 2),"%"),character(1))]
span_x <- diff(range(xy$x)); span_y <- diff(range(xy$y))
p <- ggplot()+
  geom_segment(data=edges,aes(x=x,y=y,xend=xend,yend=yend,colour=realm,
                             linewidth=clade_abundance),alpha=.55,lineend="round")+
  scale_linewidth_continuous(range=c(.25,2.8),transform="sqrt",guide="none")+
  geom_point(data=xy[rank!="root"],aes(x=x,y=y),shape=21,fill="white",colour="#AAA9A4",size=1.1,stroke=.2)+
  geom_point(data=xy[rank!="root"],aes(x=x,y=y,size=clade_abundance,fill=realm),shape=21,colour="white",stroke=.3)+
  geom_point(data=xy[rank=="root"],aes(x=x,y=y),shape=21,fill="white",colour="#555555",size=2.7)+
  geom_label_repel(data=xy[rank!="root"],aes(x=x,y=y,label=ifelse(show_label,label_text,"")),
    seed=913,size=3.2,min.segment.length=0,segment.colour="#888888",segment.size=.22,
    box.padding=.6,point.padding=.5,point.size=14,force=2,max.overlaps=Inf,
    max.iter=100000,max.time=10,linewidth=0,label.padding=.18,fill="white",
    colour="#252525",lineheight=.98)+
  scale_size_area(max_size=14,breaks=c(.01,.1,.5,.8),labels=label_percent(accuracy=1),name="Mean relative abundance")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=colours,name="Viral realm")+
  scale_colour_manual(values=colours,guide="none")+
  coord_equal(xlim=range(xy$x)+c(-.12,.12)*span_x,ylim=range(xy$y)+c(-.12,.12)*span_y,clip="off")+
  theme_void(base_size=10)+theme(legend.position="bottom",legend.box="vertical",
    legend.title=element_text(size=10),legend.text=element_text(size=9),
    plot.margin=margin(10,12,10,12))+guides(fill=guide_legend(order=1,override.aes=list(size=4)),
      size=guide_legend(order=2,override.aes=list(fill="#65798F")))
dir.create(file.path(output,"figures"),recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(output,"tables"))
fwrite(nodes,file.path(output,"tables/tree_nodes.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(xy,file.path(output,"tables/tree_layout.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(edges,file.path(output,"tables/tree_edges.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(assigned,file.path(output,"tables/deepest_assignments.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(totals,file.path(output,"tables/sample_denominators.tsv"),sep="\t")
write.tree(tree,file.path(output,"global_taxonomy.nwk"))
ggsave(file.path(output,"figures/global_votu_abundance_tree.pdf"),p,
       device=grDevices::pdf,useDingbats=FALSE,width=13,height=10,units="in")
writeLines(c("Review only. Manuscript unchanged.",
  "Global taxonomy tree of 634 high-quality, viral-gene-positive vOTUs; 12 equally weighted samples.",
  "Area denotes mean relative mapped-read abundance within each taxonomic clade. Branch width uses a square-root abundance scale; colour denotes realm.",
  "Small grey rings retain the positions of very low-abundance nodes. The central hollow node is the full catalogue, not an abundance-scaled observation.",
  "Parent and descendant abundances are nested, not additive. Direct assignments ending at internal nodes remain in their clade abundance.",
  "Labels: groups with >=0.05% directly assigned mean abundance, plus realm roots and classes with >=1% clade abundance. All nodes are retained in the tree and tables.",
  "r_: realm; k_: kingdom; p_: phylum; c_: class; o_: order; f_: family; sf_: subfamily; g_: genus; s_: species.",
  "Not an evolutionary-distance phylogeny, treatment comparison, or proof of phage-host interactions.",
  capture.output(sessionInfo())),file.path(output,"REVIEW_README.txt"))
input_paths <- c(input_paths,code=file.path(repo,"analysis/votu_global_abundance_tree.qmd"),
                 style=file.path(repo,"R/figure_style.R"))
fwrite(data.table(input=names(input_paths),path=unname(input_paths),sha256=vapply(input_paths,hash,character(1))),
       file.path(output,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
files <- list.files(output,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(path=substring(files,nchar(output)+2L),sha256=vapply(files,hash,character(1))),
       file.path(output,"output_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
print(nodes[rank %in% c("root","realm","class","unclassified"),.(taxon,rank,clade_votus,clade_abundance,direct_abundance)])
```
